hook: OpenAI: frontier models improved its Jalapeño chip
hookText: OpenAI: frontier models improved its Jalapeño chip

beats.say: OpenAI says model-proposed RTL changes cut standard-cell area about 13% and 10% in its Jalapeño inference chip's vector and matrix units, and found up to 14% PPA gains on AMD's flagship GPU IP.
Examples include a multiplier redesign with about 15% less cell area and one fewer cycle of latency.
OpenAI also benchmarked model generations on boosting throughput of the open PicoRV32 and Ibex RISC-V cores, where GPT-6.2 Astra scored highest, and notes the limits of designing from a spec.
